core_obligations: Statement (lines 2456-2470): for a differential graded algebra (A, d) and a differential graded A-module P with property (P), Hom in K(Mod_(A,d)) from P to any acyclic differential graded A-module N is zero.

Triangle reduction (proof lines 2472-2481): K(Mod_(A,d)) is triangulated; the filtration F_bullet on P given by property (P), together with the short exact sequence of Lemma lemma-property-P-sequence, produces a distinguished triangle; by the standard Derived Categories homological lemma it therefore suffices to show Hom(F_i P, N) = 0 for all i and all acyclic N.

Piece reduction (lines 2482-2485): each F_i P carries a finite filtration by admissible monomorphisms whose graded pieces are direct sums of shifts A[k]; repeating the same triangle argument reduces further to Hom(A[k], N) = 0.
Free case (lines 2486-2487): Hom(A[k], N) = 0 for acyclic N follows from Lemma lemma-hom-from-shift-free.
proof_roadmap: Filter P by the property (P) filtration and pass to the associated distinguished triangles.
Reduce to the graded pieces, which are direct sums of shifts of A.
Conclude with the vanishing of Hom from a free shift into an acyclic module.
difficulty_reason: K-projectivity lemma (statement 2456-2470, proof 2472-2487): a differential graded module with property (P) is right-orthogonal to acyclic modules in the homotopy category - the proof is the standard three-step reduction (filtration triangles, admissible pieces, free shifts), each reduction stated with its justification and the terminal case delegated to the in-source free-shift lemma; no architectural step is omitted. H2: routine reduction chain.
